scope: Canonical human-approved Git decision records only; staging artifacts, kernel Decision transport DTOs, traces and generated indexes are excluded.
source_state: Schema and one record exist in the active checkout's unrelated pending merge. Neither this source store nor its schema exists in the isolated aura-domain-graph checkout or active immutable Aura source snapshot. This review does not authorize merging or publishing the uncommitted source record.

authorities.role: Generated Draft 2020-12 structural gate, exact reviewed schema embedded below.
Frozen extra-forbidding DecisionRecord and 14 nested models; internal consistency validation and semantic defaults.
Schema, model, filename, duplicate identity, vocabulary, inter-record links and generated-index validation.
UTF-8 400000-byte bound, YAML plain subset validation and original-source parsing.
Component IDs, AC change/risk enums, roadmap IDs and declared rule globs provide existing filter vocabularies.
Only resolved, human-approved runtime decisions become staged records. Runtime status is not a DecisionRecord field.
Canonical store publication and append-only corrections.
Git decision-file canonical storage, records as precedent evidence.
Human approval authority, Git source authority, append-only correction lifecycle.

record_identity.selection: One record per direct docs/decisions/*.yaml file. Canonical filenames are dec-<16 lowercase hex>.yaml. Inspect all YAML in that folder and reject unexpected filenames rather than silently ignoring malformed candidates. Do not ingest docs/decisions/index.json.
record_identity.native_id: Exact authored id matching ^dec-[0-9a-f]{16}$; filename stem must equal id. Prefix the graph canonical identity by kind under the coordinator's new-kind collision policy, while retaining exact native_id.
record_identity.source_path: Repository-relative YAML source path inside the supplied immutable root.
record_identity.locator: Empty string: the entire YAML mapping is the record.
record_identity.metadata: Deep copy of the exact parsed source mapping after read-only validation; no model_dump output because it inserts defaults and strips strings.
record_identity.title: Authored title; validation rejects absent, wrong-typed, empty and whitespace-only titles.
record_identity.description: Authored description if present, otherwise an empty presentation-only description. Never inject that fallback into metadata.
record_identity.derived: No authored fields are derived. Any validator/schema version or canonical-store classification belongs separately in derived, never inside metadata.

approval.note: approved_at is the decision's updated_at: the kernel Decision had no approved_at field when this decision was approved (added by #KernelDecisionStore).

Approval.description: Who approved the decision and when; `approved` is the only status a record can have.
Approval.title: Approval

Correction.description: One append-only correction: why the decision was corrected, by whom, and what it kept.
Correction.title: Correction

FinalOutcome.description: What later happened to the decision (concept section 15 `final_outcome`).
FinalOutcome.title: FinalOutcome

PrecedentNote.description: An earlier decision the kernel considered for this one, and what became of it.
PrecedentNote.title: PrecedentNote

PreservedOriginal.description: What a correction preserves of the original record (never edited, only kept).
PreservedOriginal.title: PreservedOriginal

RankedOption.description: One option's place in the kernel ranking shown to the human (evidence, never authority).
RankedOption.title: RankedOption

Rationale.description: Why the option was chosen; `origin` says who wrote it (a template, never hidden Jev).
Rationale.title: Rationale

RecordAssessment.description: How the decision was assessed: the ranking a human saw, and the model's confidence.
RecordAssessment.title: RecordAssessment

RecordCriterion.description: One criterion the options were weighed against.
RecordCriterion.title: RecordCriterion

RecordEvidence.description: A reference to one evidence item: where it was read, its hash and the revision (no text).
RecordEvidence.title: RecordEvidence

RecordOption.description: One option that was weighed; assumptions are kept verbatim (never edited later).
RecordOption.title: RecordOption

RecordProvenance.description: Concept section 12 provenance: where, when and under which versions it was made.
RecordProvenance.title: RecordProvenance

SourceRevision.description: Repository revision a fact was read at (commit plus dirty flag).
SourceRevision.title: SourceRevision

TaskContext.description: What the run was asked and where (concept section 15 `task_context`).
TaskContext.title: TaskContext

exact_reviewed_schema.description: One filed decision (`docs/decisions/<id>.yaml`), a plain-YAML subset (see module note).
exact_reviewed_schema.title: DecisionRecord

property_exposure.root: Expose every authored simple scalar/list under its original field name, except reserved graph-bookkeeping collisions. id, kind, repository_id, title and components must retain their exact source values under escaped pointer keys if the graph owns the ordinary property.
property_exposure.nested: Expose all nested scalar and homogeneous scalar-list leaves under RFC 6901 pointer names. Preserve object-array indices, option/criterion/evidence IDs and correlation. Examples: /options/0/id, /options/0/assumptions, /approval/approved_by, /provenance/repository_revision/dirty, /assessment/ranking/0/scores/<escaped criterion id>, /corrections/0/preserved/evidence_ids.
property_exposure.shape: Retain container shape, ordering, explicit nulls and empty containers. The lossless native-property encoder must round-trip the exact source mapping. Preserve numeric relevance/confidence/scores and boolean dirty/repository_wide as typed values.
property_exposure.timestamps: The native schema requires strings matching its timestamp pattern. Keep exact quoted timestamp strings. An unquoted YAML timestamp parsed as datetime is a schema violation, not permission to change its source type.
property_exposure.relationships: Any future SUPERSEDES, RELATED or evidence-reference relationships supplement the exact authored fields; they do not erase them. A staged approval, graph property or native_record marker cannot create canonical authority.

required_and_default_semantics: Eleven top-level fields are structurally required: id, repository_id, title, decision_type, question, selected_option_id, task_context, rationale, options, approval, provenance.

All fixed record and nested object shapes forbid extra properties. Only assessment.ranking[].scores and provenance.decision_versions allow arbitrary map keys of their declared numeric/string value type.
Every present field must satisfy the reviewed schema. Preserve optional omissions; schema/model defaults may be used in temporary validation calculations only, never materialized into metadata.

Factory defaults omitted from the generated schema include most lists/maps and nested assessment/final_outcome/provenance.repository_revision/correction.preserved. Their omission is valid and must remain distinguishable from authored [] or {}.
Explicit null is accepted only where an anyOf null branch exists. Optional does not imply nullable: description=null, approval=null, components=null and final_outcome=null are invalid.
Nested source_version and nullable provenance fields may be explicit null. Keep it distinct from absence. Preserve empty lists/maps without synthesizing element properties.
Pydantic's str_strip_whitespace is not a license to alter authored strings. Validate required nonempty strings against whitespace-only values, but expose the unchanged valid source value.
lifecycle: The recorded approval block is mandatory: approval_status must be exactly approved, approved_by must match ^human(:[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._@-]{0,127})?$, and approved_at must match the schema UTC timestamp pattern.

The runtime builder additionally requires status=resolved before a record exists; the canonical record schema has no status field, so do not invent or require a top-level resolved status during graph ingestion.

The source is a filed, immutable Git decision. Run artifacts, pending runtime decisions and Langfuse traces are not canonical substitutes. The current pending merge's record must not be copied into an immutable source generation.

Old approved decisions remain evidence when corrected or superseded. Preserve original selected option, evidence and assumptions. Corrections append reason/time/human actor/successor/preserved originals; original record metadata must not be rewritten by graph ingestion.
final_outcome.status is a later observation enum pending/confirmed/corrected/abandoned, distinct from approval_status. A corrected or abandoned outcome does not erase the original approval trail.

The existing source validation only verifies recorded approval format; it does not cryptographically prove a human event. Graph projection does not grant permissions or make a record self-authorizing.

portable_validation.function: validate_metadata(raw: Mapping[str, object]) -> None, raising a descriptive ValueError on any structural or record-internal violation; must not mutate raw.
portable_validation.schema_strategy: Bundle the exact reviewed data-only schema as decision_schema.json and validate with jsonschema.Draft202012Validator. No kernel imports and no execution of snapshot Python code. Validate the bundled schema itself; pin schema ID/version and reviewed content/hash in tests. A source checkout schema may be checked for compatibility but cannot replace or weaken the trusted validator.

dependency.repository_dependency_declaration: No jsonschema declaration found by rg across requirements, pyproject, setup or Pipfile/lock filenames in isolated checkout. Coordinator should ensure the knowledge runtime dependency mechanism includes this already-installed dependency.

internal_checks: Schema validation first, against raw authored values with no coercion/default insertion; reject non-mappings and forbidden extra fields.

Reject whitespace-only strings where the model declares min_length=1, including title, repository_id, question, task_context.goal, rationale.text, option.title, criterion.question, evidence.locator/category, provenance.run_id and correction.reason.
Option, criterion and evidence IDs must each be unique within their own lists.
selected_option_id must resolve to an options[].id.
Every options[].evidence_ids and criteria[].evidence_ids value must resolve to evidence[].id.
Each supersedes, superseded_by and related value must match the decision-ID pattern; none may name this record's id.
Require at least one nonempty components/change_target/risk_surface/roadmap_phase/file_globs list, or repository_wide exactly true.

Do not add semantic restrictions that the reviewed validator does not impose: ranking IDs/scores need not resolve to local options/criteria; precedent IDs need not resolve within the current store; selected_rank need not equal the selected option's ranking; source revision commit strings are not constrained to a SHA; correction.new_selected_option_id need not resolve to this old record's options.
extract_checks: Missing docs/decisions directory or an empty directory returns [], without requiring the source schema or importing kernel modules. Malformed present sources must fail explicitly.

For each direct YAML source, enforce repository containment, UTF-8 decoding, the 400000-byte bound, mapping shape and the plain YAML subset: reject anchors, aliases, explicit tags, flow mappings and multiple documents. Flow sequences are allowed by the existing plain-subset checker.
Run validate_metadata(raw), verify the source filename stem equals raw.id, reject duplicate IDs, and retain exact raw metadata.

Validate existing vocabularies from the same immutable root: components keys from docs/components.json; change_target/risk_surface enums from config/ac_store_schema.json; roadmap_phase IDs from docs/roadmap.json; file_globs values from templates/rules/*.md frontmatter globs. Do not invent membership defaults or values.

After all records are read, each supersedes/superseded_by/related target must exist in this store. If A.superseded_by contains B, B.supersedes must contain A. Every non-null corrections[].superseded_by target must exist.

The canonical source validator also checks the generated index. Graph projection should not ingest that index as another entity. Either validate index freshness with a portable data reader, or explicitly record index freshness as an upstream source-validation requirement; never claim full validate_store parity if it is omitted.
Source schema compatibility is a bounded data-only check when present. Unsupported schema revisions must fail explicitly instead of silently dropping new fields.
portable_validation.publication_guard: The general snapshot validator must decode each canonical Decision's authored _native_projection and call validate_metadata, verify its native/source identity and canonical path, and retain source-generation provenance. The native_record flag alone cannot skip the existing synthetic/approval protections. Extraction handles root-dependent vocabulary/store-link checks; publication-time raw validation still enforces approval and record-internal correctness after serialization.

tests: No source directory and an empty source directory return [] on the real isolated checkout; no source schema/kernel imports occur.
A representative complete approved record preserves every one of the 31 root fields and every nested structure through extract and native property round-trip.
Minimal valid authored record retains all allowed omitted optional fields as absent, while a full record preserves explicit nullable values, [] and {} without introducing defaults.

Reject missing approval, approval_status=pending/rejected, host/kernel approvers, missing/wrong timestamp, selected-option mismatch, duplicate option/criterion/evidence IDs, unresolved cited evidence, self-links and empty classification.
Reject nested extra fields and wrong primitive/container types, including booleans supplied as numeric rankings, null in non-nullable fields, and datetime objects replacing schema-required strings.
Reject wrong filename, unexpected YAML filename, duplicate record ID, unknown vocabulary values, unresolved links and inconsistent superseded_by reciprocity.
Preserve valid corrected/superseded records including original fields and append-only correction objects; do not treat non-pending final_outcome as lack of approval.
Raw snapshot publication guard rejects a forged native_record=true Decision missing approved canonical metadata; mutation test should demonstrate this protection.
Zero Decision records in current immutable active source remains an honest zero; the pending merge's single record is not automatically copied or published.
